prts_source: https://prts.wiki/w/沉沦者的黑流树海/黑流数据库
prts_rule: 由收藏品迷藏的效果生成，立即揭示；前往可获得恋家果、光彩松露或板藤。
marker_visibility_interpretation: Immediate visibility of a marker is independent of observation of its underlying node. Publish the overlay position, preserve node masking, and do not count marker visibility as a node discovery.

initial_region_entry.basis: 开始探索 lists starting reward before initial recruitment and 区域 I. Client cargo_4 zone_into_node_attach_buff does not exclude zone_1.
initial_region_entry.runtime: After initial formal recruitment, run owned-relic on_floor_enter once behind first_region_enter_done. This includes cargo_4 acquired from the starting reward, without repeating base resources or retroactively marking the current region on later acquisition.

implementation_notes: The marker is an overlay on an existing eligible node, not the WISH node type.
Publishing this marker does not reveal the underlying node or trigger grass appraisal. Only ordinary node discovery can do that.
Starting reward selection must still hide first-map marker coordinates and generation logs.
This correction does not add another reward or alter the existing one-time marker completion hook.
unverified: Marked-node selection probabilities remain an explicitly uniform modelling prior.
Reward member frequencies remain unknown; the existing uniform pool prior is unchanged.
PRTS describes a repeated door-exit marker interaction but the client's marker whitelist excludes DOOR; this correction does not expand generation eligibility.
